notes.title: Visual upgrade and a special birthday cake character
notes.notes:
Cakefoot turned one year old 🎂 on May 10th! To celebrate, a birthday cake special event character was added to the game, available to use until May 31st.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914703/e963f75c4c1e196d81743cc73fe1fc467f2d2564.gif[/img]

The latest version introduces new background graphics, optimized to run smoothly on any system. In addition to being a welcome visual upgrade, the graphics also help distinguish the four chapters of the game. Can you make it to the 🔥 world?

[previewyoutube=R-0Vy_gKyWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Leaderboards are next up 🫡

notes.title: 50K Deaths!
notes.notes:
Against all odds players persevere to surpass 50,000 punishing deaths toward turning the tables on arcade game Cakefoot 👍

There are many more deaths across all platforms, and a global stat counter is being planned for a future update. A live Steam deaths counter is available now updating daily 📈 on the homepage of [url=https://dank.game]dank.game[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914703/a9c34fd697af24701200948236756b4434c316f0.png[/img]

Leaderboards and graphics upgrades are scheduled for the next update 🧪

notes.title: Version 1.4.3: Protect game saves
notes.notes:
Version 1.4.3 adds a pop up confirmation alert when attempting to start a new quest or arcade run if there is an in-progress game saved. This adds some protection, so an accidental button press won't delete your save file!

Also in this version - background music streams directly from file instead of being loaded into memory, so the game loads quicker 🐎💨

notes.title: Deck compatibility sale 🥳 + MAGFest arcade!
notes.notes:
Cakefoot is officially [b]Steam Deck verified[/b]! Verification came just in time for [url=super.magfest.org]MAGFest[/url] where Cakefoot will be playable in the [url=https://x.com/magindiearcade]indie arcade[/url] on an arcade cabinet in the [url=https://arcadecommons.org/]Arcade Commons[/url] section. To celebrate, Cakefoot is [b]30% off on Steam[/b] for the next two weeks. If you liked Cakefoot at MAGFest, are looking for an addition to your Deck library, or were waiting for a good discount, grab your copy [b]before Feb. 4th[/b].

A second Cakefoot cabinet is currently in production by dank.game, [url=wonderville.nyc]Wonderville[/url], and artist Dr. Begonia. This cabinet will be launching in San Francisco, CA later this year.

notes.title: Version 1.4.0: Achievement pop-ups
notes.notes:
Achievements pop-up at the top of the screen when unlocked. This is in addition to the Steam built-in achievement pop-up. Overall achievement progress can now be viewed on the title screen under the achievements menu!

Stats are also displayed on the title screen under their own stats menu. Do you want to know how many fish have killed you? Now you can find out.

There is also a much needed upgrade to fonts, both the font itself and the way the text is drawn. Menus, buttons, the scoreboard, and all text should look slightly better, especially when running with a small window size.

Thanks for playing Cakefoot in 2024, its first year. Looking forward to 2025! 🥳

notes.title: Version 1.3.0: Audio improvements
notes.notes: This update introduces new background music: unique medleys of VGM mixed with the Cakefoot theme music, one medley for each of the four chapters of the game. Sound effects have been buffed as well - sounds will pan to the left and right depending on where the character is on screen. Enjoy! 🎵🎶

notes.title: Version 1.2.1: Fix walking backward achievements
notes.notes: This fix prevents the walking backward achievements from triggering prematurely. If this bug affected you, see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2928878449]this method[/url] for resetting the achievement using the Steam console -- or leave a message here and I will reset it. ːenteringsteamvrː

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Achievements and stats
notes.notes:
Achievements and stats are [b]finally live[/b]!

There are 39 achievements to collect and 21 stats to track. Some achievements introduce new challenges to the game like [b]walking backward[/b] or [b]walking without letting go[/b] of the button, while others are based on logging in for [b]consecutive days[/b] or on [b]certain dates[/b]. ːsteamsunnyː

A full announcement will come next week if this build can be confirmed to be running stably.

Another small update in this version is the ability to [b]save fullscreen, bgm and sfx preferences[/b].

Version 1.2 introduces a lot of automated tests to the build system to help prevent crashes - but since this is still a large update with a lot of changes to the game engine, there is a good chance there will be issues such as achievements not triggering. Feedback or bug reports on the discussion board or emailed to [i]cocktail.frank@dank.game[/i] are much appreciated.

Please enjoy, and thank you for playing Cakefoot ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.1.4: prevent crashes from corrupt save data
notes.notes:
If the save data file becomes corrupt, like if the power dies during a save operation or a new bug in the program happens, the game is now able to start without crashing.

Unfortunately, the save data will not be recovered (that feature will be added in a future update). If your save data is corrupted, email me at cocktail.frank at dank.game and I will provide a save file to restore your data.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3: Bug fixes, and logging disabled
notes.notes:
This is a bug fix update that may slightly improve performance. Logging is also disabled by default (it can be enabled by editing config.json).
[list]
[*] Remove all calls to `glGetError`
[*] Disable logging by default[/list]Thank you for playing Cakefoot! New features are being planned for version 1.2 ːenteringsteamvrː

notes.title: Version 1.1.2: add version string to pause menu
notes.notes:
Small update to help identify technical issues ⚙

[list]
[*]Add version string to pause menu
[*]Enable vsync
[/list]Now you can get the version of Cakefoot from the pause menu by clicking the gear or pressing ESC during gameplay. Contact me at cocktail.frank@dank.game if you are experiencing issues with the game, technical or otherwise, and let me know the version and platform you're using!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: fix arcade mode bug
notes.notes: The bank HUD upgrade introduced a bug preventing arcade mode from running because it was looking for an old save progress field called "arcade coin". This update removes the "arcade coin" field entirely in favor of the new bank save progress field.

notes.title: Update to 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Fixes a couple of bugs introduced in 1.0.5.

[list][*]Prevent the coin HUD from being transformed in the display effects modes.[*]Fix a bug which loaded the wrong level's coin bank status when resuming a game saved at a checkpoint[/list]Future updates will use the last digit for bug fixes and minor changes and the second digit for new features or other major updates.

notes.title: Cakefoot officially launches on Steam!
notes.notes:
Cakefoot is now available to add to your library! Alongside the Steam launch, version 1.1.0 has been released with improvements to the coin system. It is now easy to tell whether the coin has been collected on each level.
[list][*]The coin appears above your head after you grab it. It remains there while you are holding it, before it has been added to the bank.
[*]Once you reach a checkpoint or the end of a level, the coin is added to the bank. If you don't make it to the safe point, the coin is given back!
[*]The bank now appears in the HUD, showing clearly which level coins have been collected during a run.
[*]The coin sticking out in the bank indicates which level you are on in the quest and how close you are to the final level.[/list]By the way, the coin system is inspired by the strawberries in Celeste. Enjoy Cakefoot on Steam! 🍓

notes.title: Update to corrected Linux build for Ubuntu-18 instead of Debian-Testing
notes.notes: This replaces the Linux testing build with the Ubuntu-18 build which has wider compatibility

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released!
notes.notes:
Notable improvements to input support include:
[list] [*]New dynamic UI that switches between gamepad and mouse modes automatically
[*]Ability to add a gamepad or switch to a different gamepad while the game is running
[*]Support for either D-pad or analog stick
[*]Improved visibility of selected button in gamepad mode
[*]Home button pauses the game before the Steam interface is launched[/list]Further upgrades for better Steam input support and gamepad customization are planned 😺👍
